# Jess Braids

> Hair braiding based in Austin, Texas. Knotless, boho knotless, stitch braids, butterfly braids and feed-ins, by appointment at My Salon Suite in The Linc, North Austin. Clean parts, on time, and Jess checks you're comfortable the whole way through.

- Phone: (512) 233-9233
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Manor, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.5 from 6 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/jess-braids/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/jess-braids/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Smooth knotless and box braids with neat, even parts, waist length or longer, in natural black or color like burgundy and auburn.
- Boho knotless: Boho goddess knotless braids with loose curly pieces left out for a soft, full finish.
- Stitch braids: Stitch braids with crisp lines: 4-layer, zig zag, criss cross and men's designer styles.
- Feed-ins & Dutch braids: Feed-in cornrows and Dutch braids, plain or with burgundy, teal or your color braided in.
- Butterfly braids: Butterfly braids in human hair, worn down or pinned up, alone or with criss cross stitch at the front.
- Tribal & curly styles: Tribal braids with a quick weave or curly half wig, plus crochet and French curl braids.

## About
Jess is Jessica Miller, born and raised in Austin. She started braiding at 13 and founded Jess Braids in 2018. Today she works by appointment from her own suite at My Salon Suite in The Linc, on the I-35 frontage in North Austin, Monday to Saturday. Clients call her a master braider who has been in the hair game for a minute and stays up to date on the latest trends. They say she is on time, friendly and hilarious, always willing to work with you, and checks in the whole way through to make sure nothing is hurting. And yes, she takes last-minute appointments.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Text Jess at (512) 233-9233 (texting is best) with the style you want and a photo of the look. You can also book online on Booksy or send a request on this site.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Jess works by appointment, but she does take last-minute appointments. Text (512) 233-9233 to check today's openings.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM, by appointment. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: My Salon Suite at The Linc, 6406 N Interstate 35 Frontage Rd #2300, Austin, TX 78752, on the I-35 frontage in North Austin. An easy drive from Pflugerville, Round Rock, Manor and Hutto.
- Q: What styles do you do?
  A: Knotless and box braids, boho knotless, stitch braids (4-layer, zig zag, criss cross, men's designer), feed-ins and Dutch braids, butterfly braids, tribal quick weaves, crochet and French curl braids.
- Q: Will it hurt?
  A: Clients say Jess keeps checking in and asks if anything is hurting, so tell her any time something feels tight.
